import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int P;
    static int[] factorial;
    static int[] inv_factorial;
    static int[] bit_count;
    static int[] bit_mask;
    static long[][] suma;
    static long[][] sumc;
    static long[][] dp;
    static long[][] temp;

    static int mod_exp(int base, int exp) {
        int result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (int) (((long) result * base) % P);
            }
            base = (int) (((long) base * base) % P);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int L = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();

        factorial = new int[L + 1];
        inv_factorial = new int[L + 1];
        bit_count = new int[L + 1];
        bit_mask = new int[20];

        factorial[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; ++i) {
            factorial[i] = (int) (((long) factorial[i - 1] * i) % P);
            bit_count[i] = bit_count[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        long total = mod_exp(K, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(total);
            return;
        }

        inv_factorial[L] = mod_exp(factorial[L], P - 2);
        for (int i = L; i > 0; --i) {
            inv_factorial[i - 1] = (int) (((long) inv_factorial[i] * i) % P);
        }

        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 1; (1 << i) <= L; ++i) {
            if ((L >> i & 1) == 1) {
                bit_mask[n++] = 1 << i;
            }
        }

        int m = 1 << n;

        suma = new long[20][m];
        sumc = new long[20][m];
        dp = new long[20][m];
        temp = new long[20][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            int sum_bits = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    sum_bits += bit_mask[j];
                }
            }
            suma[bit_count[i]][i] = inv_factorial[sum_bits];
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            long[] arr = suma[t];
            for (int len = m; len >= 2; len >>= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        arr[j + k + step] += arr[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                arr[j] %= P;
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            System.arraycopy(suma[t], 0, dp[t], 0, m);
        }

        int revK = 0, cnt = 0;
        for (int temp_k = K; temp_k != 0; temp_k >>= 1) {
            revK = (revK << 1) | (temp_k & 1);
            ++cnt;
        }
        --cnt;
        revK >>= 1;

        for (; cnt > 0; --cnt, revK >>= 1) {
            for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                Arrays.fill(temp[t], 0);
            }

            for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                    long[] f = temp[a + b];
                    long[] g = dp[a];
                    long[] h = dp[b];
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                    dp[t][j] = temp[t][j] % P;
                }
            }

            if ((revK & 1) == 1) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                    Arrays.fill(temp[t], 0);
                }

                for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; a + b <= n; ++b) {
                        long[] f = temp[a + b];
                        long[] g = dp[a];
                        long[] h = suma[b];
                        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                            f[j] += g[j] * h[j];
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        dp[t][j] = temp[t][j] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            System.arraycopy(dp[t], 0, sumc[t], 0, m);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= n; ++t) {
            long[] arr = sumc[t];
            for (int len = 2; len <= m; len <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0, step = len >> 1; j < m; j += len) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < step; ++k) {
                        arr[j + k + step] -= arr[j + k];
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                arr[j] = (arr[j] % P + P) % P;
            }
        }

        long ans = (total - (sumc[n][(1 << n) - 1] * factorial[L]) % P + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
